summary.text: Jay Luneau is a Democrat member of the Louisiana State Senate representing District 29, which the legislature's member page lists as covering Avoyelles, Bienville, Grant, Jackson, Lincoln, Natchitoches, Rapides, and Winn parishes. First elected in 2015, Jay Luneau chairs the Local and Municipal Affairs Committee and serves as vice chair of the Judiciary A Committee.

paragraphs.text: According to his Senate biography, Jay Luneau owns Luneau Law Office in Alexandria, where he represents individuals and small businesses in personal injury, workers' compensation, and other damage claims.
The biography says he is an adjunct professor teaching law-related courses at Northwestern State University and teaches continuing legal education courses for lawyers and paralegals.
It says he is legal counsel for Renaissance Home for Youth and is active in the Rapides Children's Advocacy Center CASA program.
The biography describes him as a lifelong resident of Central Louisiana and a graduate of Pineville High School, Louisiana Tech University, and Southern Law Center.

The Senate page lists Jay Luneau's committee assignments as Local and Municipal Affairs (chair), Judiciary A (vice chair), Health and Welfare, Revenue and Fiscal Affairs, Atchafalaya Basin Program Oversight Committee, Joint Legislative Committee on Capital Outlay, Legislative Audit Advisory Council, and Senate Select Committee on Homeland Security, and caucus and delegation affiliations as Central Louisiana Delegation Caucus and Democratic Caucus.
